methodology: The 50 latest listed uploads for each of six deliberately selected channels on independently provided Digital Creators pages. Snapshot is the source's Last Updated date, not a simultaneous YouTube API query. Not a random sample of YouTube or a matched causal experiment. All counts are observations from the source, including livestreams, shorts and compilations. The source's runtime 00:00:00 is preserved as unknown (null) rather than assumed zero. Engagement counts do not establish audience retention, unique viewers or creative quality. Titles identify rows within this source; no video IDs or direct video links are claimed.
